document.title: Student ground-truth reference census — 55-map corpus
document.purpose: Establish empirically which reference layer holds which feature count, whether the underlying student digitisation is genuinely fixed, and how the 4,744 / 4,745 / 4,746 / 4,770 family relates. Does NOT settle the Dawid-Skene comparability question; supplies the ground facts for it.
document.method: Every count parsed directly from the GeoJSON with Python json (len(features)); historical counts parsed from `git show <commit>:<path>` piped to the same parser. No count in this document is taken from any prose document.
document.constraint_honoured: This is the only file written. Nothing committed, pushed, or edited.

2_fixed_base_determination.verdict: CONFIRMED FIXED. The PI's claim holds without qualification.
evidence: `git log --follow` on the path returns exactly ONE commit: 301b511286e1b5b7bb25f8eb0834c18f36456510, 2026-04-08, 'data(inputs): add 55-map student ground truth and evaluation bounds'.
`git log --all --diff-filter=A -- '*student-mounds*'` shows no earlier path or rename — the file was born at that commit under that name.
Feature count parsed from `git show 301b51128:<path>` = 4770; feature count parsed from the working tree = 4770.
md5 of the working-tree file (2fa374bcdc3c2d30d36d2becdc170538) is byte-identical to md5 of `git show 301b51128:<path>` — the file has never been touched, not even for whitespace.

3_correction_layer_history.history_is_complete: Yes — `git log --follow` on the path returns exactly three commits, and `git log --all --diff-filter=A` confirms the file was created (not renamed into place) at dea1155fa. Every count below was parsed from `git show <commit>:<path>`.

4_the_4770_account.answer: 4,770 is the FIXED BASE — the raw student digitisation in inputs/vectors/references/student-mounds-55maps.geojson. It is current in the sense that the file is unchanged and still on disk; it is NOT the current recommended evaluation reference.

arithmetic_from_4770_to_4746.minus_52: 52 base features participating in the 26 merge clusters are absent from the reviewed layer
arithmetic_from_4770_to_4746.plus_26: 26 replacement features, each at a NEW merged-centroid coordinate, carrying _merged=true

empirical_verification_of_the_arithmetic.method: Multiset comparison of both layers on the key (source_map, round(easting,3), round(northing,3)). Both layers have as many distinct coordinate keys as features (4,770 and 4,746 respectively), so the key is unique within each layer.
empirical_verification_of_the_arithmetic.reconciliation: 28 = 26 merged replacements + 2 curator additions. All 26 _merged=true features have coordinate keys NOT present in the base (they sit at cluster centroids, per merged_centroid_x/y in results/gt-duplicate-review/gt-duplicate-decisions.csv). Both _added_2026-05-03 features likewise have keys not present in the base. 4770 - 52 + 28 = 4746. Closed exactly; nothing unaccounted for.

4_the_4770_account.semantic_account: The ~25-point gap is student double-marking, not disagreement about which mounds exist. The 26 merge clusters were all pairs separated by under 50 m; the review found a bimodal signal (merges concentrated below 50 m, zero merges in the 50-75 m band), consistent with 50 m being the true floor for genuine mound spacing in this corpus. Per commit dea1155fa the affected fraction is 26/4770 = 0.55 % of GT points.
4_the_4770_account.caution: The `uuid` property is NOT a unique identifier in the base layer: 4,770 features carry only 833 distinct uuid values (the most common, '100005e13', appears 1,162 times). It is a map-symbol code, not a feature ID. Any de-duplication, join, or D-S alignment keyed on `uuid` will be wrong. Use coordinates (plus source_map) as the join key. VERIFIED by counting.

a_fixed_student_digitisation.phrasing_note: This is the correct number for any sentence about what the students digitised. It includes 26 double-marks.

b_current_corrected_reviewed_gt.phrasing_note: This is the correct number for any sentence about the current curator-corrected reference. 4,744 and 4,745 are historical states of THIS layer, not separate layers.

6_which_run_consumed_which_reference.verified_finding: Three of the four 55-map runs' committed evaluations consumed the reviewed layer at its 4,745 state; the fourth (t0.3) consumed the 4,770 unreviewed base. NONE of the four consumed the current 4,746 state.
6_which_run_consumed_which_reference.relation_to_the_prompt_s_framing: The prompt reports an independent verification pass concluding that the IMAGE run implies 4,745 while the OTHER THREE imply 4,770. The artefact metadata inverts that split: image/text-high/text-min all recorded the reviewed layer (4,745 in force), and only t0.3 recorded the 4,770 base. Recorded here as a discrepancy to be resolved by whoever settles the D-S question — this census does not adjudicate it, because a D-S fit could have been assembled from inputs other than these evaluation.json files.
6_which_run_consumed_which_reference.inferred_not_verified: The mapping from generated_at_utc to a reference count is an INFERENCE from timestamps (the evaluation.json files record the ground-truth PATH but not its feature count). It is corroborated by the three commit subjects that state '4745' explicitly, and by the fact that all three timestamps fall strictly between baf1497a7 and 2e075eb99. It is not directly attested by a count field inside the artefacts.

8_open_items.unaccounted_numbers: None. Every one of 4,744 / 4,745 / 4,746 / 4,770 is fully explained: 4,770 is the fixed base; 4,744, 4,745 and 4,746 are three successive states of the single correction layer at commits dea1155fa, baf1497a7 and 2e075eb99 respectively.
8_open_items.residual_question_for_others: Whether the D-S fits in results/55maps-ds-summary-v2/report.md were built from the four evaluation.json artefacts audited in section 6 or from some other intermediate. Section 6 establishes what those artefacts record; it does not establish what the D-S pipeline read. That is deliberately out of scope here.
8_open_items.operational_hazard_surfaced: The t0.3 run's committed evaluation points at the UNREVIEWED 4,770 base while the other three point at the reviewed layer. Any four-way comparison drawing on outputs/55maps-*/evaluation/evaluation.json is comparing across two different references regardless of how the D-S question resolves.
